child_handoff.rtl_spec_text:
Design a synthesizable digital IP block named doMINO_aero_ctrl_safety_wrapper for ASIC implementation. The block shall not implement the physics surrogate model itself; it shall only manage deterministic control around an external DoMINO model service. The IP shall provide input/output ports for clock, active-low reset, vehicle_geometry_valid, vehicle_geometry_id or descriptor handle, flow_conditions_valid, stream_velocity_mps, model_response_valid, model_response_seq, model_response_age, drag_force_in, lift_force_in, surface_pressure_in, flow_field_valid, actuator_enable_in, and outputs actuator_command_out, actuator_command_valid, fault_status_out, fallback_active, and model_request_valid.

Functional requirements:
1) On reset, the IP shall initialize to safe fallback mode, clear all pending request/response state, deassert actuator_command_valid, and assert fallback_active until a valid operational state is established.
2) The IP shall accept flow_conditions only when stream_velocity_mps is within the inclusive envelope 20 to 55 m/s. Out-of-range values shall assert fault_status_out and force fallback.
3) The IP shall package validated geometry and flow condition metadata into a model_request packet interface for the external DoMINO service. The packetizer shall not create or assume physics outputs.
4) The IP shall maintain a request sequence counter and a response sequence checker. Any response whose sequence does not match the outstanding request, or whose age exceeds a programmable freshness threshold, shall be treated as stale and rejected.
5) The IP shall require response completeness: drag_force_in, lift_force_in, and either surface_pressure_in or flow_field_valid as defined by the integration configuration must be marked valid before any downstream command generation can occur.
6) The IP shall implement deterministic aero decision fusion logic using only validated model responses and local control policy inputs. The exact control policy may be implemented as fixed-point combinational or pipelined logic, but must be fully synthesizable and must not depend on software execution.
7) The IP shall implement command clamp logic with programmable minimum and maximum bounds for each actuator command dimension. All outputs shall be saturated to bounds before being marked valid.
8) The IP shall implement optional slew-rate limiting, where configured, using registered previous-command state and bounded delta per cycle.
9) The IP shall implement a safe fallback manager that selects a predefined command vector whenever model data are stale, invalid, incomplete, or when actuator_enable_in is deasserted. Fallback command values shall be registered constants or CSR-programmed values with deterministic reset defaults.
10) The IP shall implement a fault and timeout supervisor that raises individual sticky bits for stale response, timeout, invalid geometry, out-of-envelope flow, clamp event, and fallback entry. Sticky bits shall be clearable only by reset or explicit clear control.
11) The IP shall never directly drive actuator_command_valid from model_response_valid alone; command_valid shall be asserted only after all safety checks pass and clamping is complete.
12) The IP shall provide backpressure-safe behavior to the external model interface, including request holdoff when a previous request is outstanding and a response has not yet been accepted.
13) All internal arithmetic shall be fixed-point and synthesizable. No floating-point, dynamic memory, or unbounded loops are permitted.
14) The IP shall support parameterization for request freshness threshold, command clamp limits, optional rate limits, and fallback command vector, all as static synthesis-time parameters or small CSR registers suitable for ASIC integration.
15) The IP shall be clock-gated or enable-qualified only where synthesis-safe and must preserve functional correctness under clock gating insertion.
16) The IP shall expose fault_status_out as a packed status vector encoding at minimum: invalid_input, stale_response, timeout, clamp_active, fallback_active, and response_missing.
17) The IP shall be compatible with a higher-level architecture where the external DoMINO model may execute on a remote NIM or GPU worker. The IP must tolerate model unavailability without loss of safe control.
18) If inference is not executed or no valid response is present, the IP shall remain in fallback mode and shall not invent or synthesize surrogate outputs.

Microarchitecture guidance:
- Use a request state machine with states IDLE, REQUEST_SENT, WAIT_RESPONSE, VALIDATE_RESPONSE, APPLY_CLAMP, OUTPUT, and FALLBACK.
- Use registered handshake signals on all external interfaces.
- Use compare-and-saturate units for clamp logic.
- Use sticky fault registers and a separate clear path.
- Use one-cycle valid strobes or ready/valid handshakes as appropriate for ASIC integration.
- Use parameterized bit widths for command vector and status vector.

Non-goals:
- No implementation of the physics surrogate or GPU inference engine.
- No training logic.
- No floating-point model execution.

architecture_decisions: Use a split architecture: the DoMINO physics model remains external to RTL as a surrogate service, while the ASIC implements all deterministic control, safety, and interface orchestration around it.
Treat the model outputs as advisory inputs to the actuator decision path, not as direct actuator drive signals.
Support the required model inputs vehicle_geometry and flow_conditions, with geometry sourced from DrivAerML-style STL reference data and stream velocity constrained to the specified envelope.
Assume remote execution on a future NVIDIA-hosted NIM or ChipLoop GPU worker, but do not depend on inference availability for safe operation.
Implement stale-command rejection using time-to-live and sequence checking on model response packets.
Clamp all actuator commands to preconfigured bounds before output to downstream active-aero hardware.
Provide a safe fallback mode that is entered on model timeout, invalid packet, stale response, interface fault, or any safety monitor violation.
Use deterministic fixed-point processing for command formatting, validity checks, and safety limits to keep the ASIC synthesizable and verifiable.
Keep all inference-specific functionality outside the ASIC boundary; the chip only ingests model outputs when available and valid.
Design for automotive deployment with explicit fail-safe behavior and no reliance on undefined predictions in architecture-definition mode.

blocks.function: Accepts vehicle geometry metadata and reference geometry identifiers, validates format, and prepares geometry descriptors for the external model interface.
blocks.name: Geometry Ingest and Normalize
blocks.notes: No STL parsing engine is required beyond metadata handling unless later integration expands scope.

blocks.function: Captures stream velocity and associated flow-condition fields within the configured operating envelope.
blocks.name: Flow Conditions Register

blocks.function: Creates deterministic request packets for the DoMINO service with geometry and flow-condition payload descriptors.
blocks.name: Model Request Packetizer
blocks.notes: Model call is external to RTL; this block only prepares outbound request metadata.

blocks.function: Checks response validity, response age, packet sequence, and completeness of model outputs.
blocks.name: Model Response Monitor
blocks.notes: Rejects stale or malformed model commands and outputs.

blocks.function: Combines validated surrogate outputs with local policy rules to generate candidate actuator commands.
blocks.name: Aero Decision Fusion
blocks.notes: Must not fabricate outputs when model inference is unavailable; supports pass-through of safe fallback.

blocks.function: Applies hard bounds and optional slew-rate limits to actuator commands.
blocks.name: Command Clamp and Rate Limit
blocks.notes: Ensures outputs remain within actuator-safe operating limits.

blocks.function: Selects a predefined safe aerodynamic configuration when model data are invalid, stale, or missing.
blocks.name: Safe Fallback Manager
blocks.notes: Fallback state must be deterministic and latched until recovery criteria are met.

blocks.function: Monitors timeouts, freshness windows, interface errors, and invalid data flags.
blocks.name: Fault and Timeout Supervisor
blocks.notes: Drives safe mode entry and error reporting.

blocks.function: Formats final commands for downstream active-aero actuators and system controller interfaces.
blocks.name: Actuator Output Formatter

constraints: Must reference DrivAerML reference geometry or compatible equivalent metadata
Must be valid for the selected model interface

constraints: Contains only validated geometry and flow-condition descriptors
interfaces.name: model_request

Must include freshness metadata and sequence information

Must obey safe fallback on error
Must not propagate stale model commands

interfaces.name: fault_status

architecture.product_name: DoMINO Active Aero Control ASIC Front-End
architecture.product_summary: An ASIC-oriented digital control architecture for an AI-assisted active-aerodynamics system using NVIDIA's pretrained DoMINO Automotive Aero model interface. The chip wraps the non-RTL surrogate model with deterministic hardware for geometry/flow-condition packaging, command validation, safety gating, actuator clamping, freshness enforcement, and fallback control. No model inference is assumed or predicted in architecture mode.

safety_requirements: Reject any model response or command packet that exceeds the configured freshness window.
Reject any packet with invalid sequence ordering or missing required fields.
Clamp all actuator commands to predefined safe minimum and maximum values before output.
Enter safe fallback mode on model timeout, stale data, malformed packet, or interface fault.
Hold fallback mode until a valid fresh response and system-clear condition are observed.
Reject out-of-envelope flow conditions, including stream_velocity_mps outside 20 to 55.
Prevent direct passthrough from model outputs to actuators without safety validation.
Expose fault_status for integration with vehicle supervisory control.
verification_goals: Prove that out-of-range stream_velocity_mps values are rejected and force safe fallback.
Prove that stale model responses are rejected based on age and sequence mismatch.
Prove that actuator commands never exceed configured clamp limits.
Prove that fallback_active is asserted on reset and on any safety violation.
Prove that actuator_command_valid is never asserted unless all required validations pass.
Prove that missing or invalid model response fields prevent output command generation.
Prove that sticky fault bits set on the first occurrence of each monitored fault condition.
Prove that safe fallback persists until a valid fresh response and clear condition are present.
Prove that request/response sequencing prevents reuse of old model outputs.
Validate that the architecture does not assume inference execution when inference_status is not_executed.
Check synthesizability constraints: fixed-point arithmetic only, no floating-point or unbounded control structures.
Confirm compatibility with external model execution over future NVIDIA-hosted NIM or ChipLoop GPU worker interfaces.

digital_ip_spec.name: adaptive_aero_control_ip
digital_ip_spec.purpose: Low-latency sensor aggregation, safety monitoring, and active-aero actuator control around an external GPU surrogate.
requirements: Fail safe when surrogate command is stale or invalid
Clamp every actuator command to software-programmable limits
Expose timestamp, validity, fault, and model-version registers
Permit deterministic fallback control without the GPU service
